crossRefs.note: What shall I testify to you? What shall I liken to you, daughter of Jerusalem? What shall I compare to you, that I may…
He said, “How will we liken God’s Kingdom? Or with what parable will we illustrate it?
He said, “What is God’s Kingdom like? To what shall I compare it?
You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth…
Most certainly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.
Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away, until all these things are accomplished.
“To what then should I compare the people of this generation? What are they like?

parallels.note: “To what then should I compare the people of this generation? What are they like?
They are like children who sit in the marketplace, and call to one another, saying, ‘We piped to you, and you didn’t…

translations.web: “But to what shall I compare this generation? It is like children sitting in the marketplaces, who call to their companions
translations.bsb: To what can I compare this generation? They are like children sitting in the marketplaces and calling out to others:
translations.kjv: But whereunto shall I liken this generation? It is like unto children sitting in the markets, and calling unto their fellows,
